config.scope: Exact ordered private-pair global suit-orbit transfer from independently enumerated historical counts, without new ranking. All 24 whole-game suit images plus one four-pair game with three active BB hands. Current resource caps remain. Complete warm calls exclude source-table preparation and historical loading; allocation trace is not RSS; no cold-call speed comparison.

historical_physical_count_evidence.scope: Previously independently enumerated physical pair counts. Reused exactly; no current full-board enumeration or new-pair coverage claim.

methodology: 25 fixtures, three complete suit-remap + prepared solve + exact production diagnostics + JSON calls each, GC before timing. Independent toy ranking before timings; exact Fraction matrix witnesses and own-hand policy replay outside timing. Separate complete split-game warm allocation trace excludes source table, historical file loading, original full-board preparation and RSS. No cold-call or cross-source speed comparison. Suit transfers reuse original physical counts, not newly enumerated 52-card boards.

equity_preparation.scope: Exact unordered five-card boards per compatible private pair; logical counts, not time or memory guarantees.

work_budget.scope: Conservative bookkeeping and generic-CFR/reference diagnostic loop entries for the fixed two-decision tree; source preparation is charged even when an immutable table is reused. Internal ranking instructions and caller progress callbacks are excluded; total rank calls have a separate pre-enumeration cap. Not bytecode, elapsed time, allocated bytes or RSS bounds.

result.scope: Exact full-board equity for a finite heads-up preflop SB fold/shove and BB fold/call action model. Whole-hand net chip transfers including blinds and unmatched refunds. Both starting stacks exceed the big blind. No limps, non-all-in raises, later-street betting, antes, rake or multiway equilibrium.
